Connecting to the Example VPN

How to install the Example VPN client and connect from off campus.

Before you begin

You need an active example account and the Example Connect client.
Off campus, the VPN is required for the lab file server.

Windows

Install the client

  1. Download the client from the software portal.
  2. Run the installer and accept the defaults.

Connect

Open Example Connect and enter the gateway below.

gateway: vpn.example.test
group:   students
GatewayWho
vpn.example.testStudents
staff-vpn.example.testStaff
